name: Joomla
description: Joomla is a free, open-source content management system built entirely by volunteers, used to build websites and online applications with multilingual and permission-based content control.
best_for: Organizations that need multilingual websites, granular user permissions, and full design customization without licensing costs.
features: Built-in multi-language support for content and interface
Multi-user permission levels and access control groups
Fully extensible developer framework for custom builds
Completely free and open source with no vendor lock-in

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.description: The world's most widely used CMS, powering everything from blogs to large-scale websites with a vast plugin and theme ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and businesses of all sizes needing a flexible, widely supported CMS

alternatives.name: Drupal
alternatives.description: An open-source, API-first CMS for building structured, composable digital experiences across websites and channels.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises and institutions needing a highly customizable, secure CMS

alternatives.name: Wix
alternatives.description: A hosted website builder offering drag-and-drop design, templates, and integrated business tools.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses wanting a hosted, no-code website builder
